1339-1832-2034-6094.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-2034-6094.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}
When the Insect dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

238-728-5756.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Gerrard.
When Gerrard dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning up to one legendary creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Havi.
When Havi dies, it triggers, returning Gerrard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gerrard trigger from step 2, failing to exile it as it is no longer in your graveyard and returning Havi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.

728-730-7084.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Emeria Angel triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1018-3115-3557.description:
Cast Cyclonic Rift for its overload cost by paying {6}{U}, returning all nonland permanents you don't control to their owners' hands.
Deal combat damage using Brago, triggering its ability, blinking Skullwinder.
When Skullwinder enters, it triggers, returning Cyclonic Rift from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

206-339-677-5256.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

3490-5231-6458-6824.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
3490-5231-6458-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-5007-6972.description:
If Morselhoarder has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Morselhoarder has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1978-5056-6410.notablePrerequisites: You have max speed. You control at least three Goblins.
1978-5056-6410.description:
Cause Howlsquad Heavy to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Howlsquad Heavy by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Howlsquad Heavy.
Repeat from step 2.

645-1267-5231-6913.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-5231-6913.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Chameleon from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Chameleon.
Chameleon triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Chameleon
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

745-2228-3108.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Mirrorhall Mimic
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Mirrorhall Mimic by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

413-586-5060-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
413-586-5060-5258-5618.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger, adding {B}{B}{B} and untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

1339-1808-5231-6625.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature token, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Eloise's first and second abilities trigger, causing you to create a Clue token and then to surveil 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

1399-1606-2404-4452.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

413-628-2018.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that is not a Human and does not have flying.
413-628-2018.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if the creature didn't have flying.
Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
If the creature entered the battlefield in step 3, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
If the creature entered the battlefield in step 5, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

729-2440-4055-4183.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Great Oak Guardian
729-2440-4055-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Great Oak Guardian with haste.
When the token Great Oak Guardian enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Great Oak Guardian trigger, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Great Oak Guardian, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Great Oak Guardian for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Energy Refractor twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

435-2438-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Auratog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Sorin of House Markov // Sorin, Ravenous Neonate

4996-5731.description:
Cast Beacon of Immortality by paying its mana cost, doubling your life total.
If Sorin is on the battlefield as Sorin of House Markov, move to your postcombat main phase. Sorin of House Markov's second ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Sorin, Ravenous Neonate.
Activate Sorin, Ravenous Neonate's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, dealing damage to target opponent equal to the life you gained this turn.

1641-2034-4758-4875.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Promised Kannushi, adding {C}{C}.
When Promised Kannushi dies, its soulshift ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {2}, adding {G}.
Cast Promised Kannushi by paying {G}.
Repeat.

1242-2092-4474-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 4 or greater.
Paradise Mantle attached to Cinderhaze Wretch.
1242-2092-4474-4762.description:
Activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron by paying {R}{G}, giving all other creatures you control +1/+1, trample and haste until end of turn.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability and Cinderhaze Wretch by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Devoted Druid and Cinderhaze Wretch's second abilities by putting a -1/-1 counter on them, untapping them.
Repeat.

4010-4050-4231-5270.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{W} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
4010-4050-4231-5270.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it and Samwise trigger.
Resolve the Farmer Cotton trigger, creating two 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and two Food, two Clue and two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Samwise trigger, creating a Food, a Clue and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Farmer Cotton, adding {G}.
If Farmer Cotton is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing the three Foods, returning Farmer Cotton to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Halfling, adding {1}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may sacrifice them to get infinite colored mana, which can be used to cast Farmer Cotton for an arbitrarily large amount of mana to create infinite Food tokens.

933-991-2120.notablePrerequisites:
Wanderwine Prophets does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
You control at least one additional Merfolk.
933-991-2120.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Wanderwine Prophets.
Wanderwine Prophets triggers, causing you to sacrifice a Merfolk to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beggining of the end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Benthicore.
Benthicore enters the battlefield, creating two 1/1 Merfolk Wizard creature tokens.
Repeat.

1061-4844-5131.notablePrerequisites:
Timesteam Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
You have the city's blessing.
You have not cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1061-4844-5131.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Cellar Door by paying {3} and tapping it, causing you to put Timestream Navigator from the bottom of your library into your graveyard and create a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Cast Timestream Navigator from your graveyard by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

1479-1671-4488.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-1671-4488.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it, Rampaging Baloths, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
